references.text: The preceding verse introduces Shuthelah as the son of Ephraim, and this verse continues by mentioning Shuthelah's descendants.
The verse mentions Joseph's sons Manasseh and Ephraim, who were born in Egypt. Shuthelah is a descendant of Ephraim.
The first census of the tribe of Ephraim, to which Shuthelah and his descendants belonged.
Chronicles provides an extended genealogy for Ephraim that includes Shuthelah and his descendants, including Eran.
